name: Candidate
overview: The biblical portrayal of a candidate, as exemplified by Absalom, reveals a strategic approach to gaining favor without making explicit promises. Absalom positioned himself as a just leader by personally hearing the grievances of the people and expressing a desire to be appointed judge, thereby winning their hearts through personal attention and gestures of respect. This electioneering tactic, marked by subtle influence rather than overt commitments, demonstrates how a candidate may seek to build support by appealing to the people's needs and perceptions of justice.
